meta.name: Vitfolio design system
meta.description: Design language for a personal frontend-developer portfolio, derived from the visual system of kalcheuski.com and adapted for a Russian-language audience and a React codebase.

reference.author: Kiryl Kalcheuski
reference.usage: Layout, type roles, spacing, palette and motion were read from the site's public CSS and JS. The code in this project is a reimplementation, not a copy of the site's markup.

reactBits.author: David Haz

reactBits.used: Gooey Nav in the header; the contact seal and spotlight are original adaptations of the Circular Text / Spotlight Card ideas, not copies.

licenses.fonts: Inter — SIL OFL 1.1. IBM Plex Mono — SIL OFL 1.1. License files live in public/fonts.

tokens.usage: Page background, inner tray, eyes of the nav mark.

tokens.name: --surface
tokens.usage: Tray shell, cards, chips, image plates.

tokens.usage: Inner plates on surface, text on ink.

tokens.name: --ink
tokens.usage: Body text, marks, CTA fill, selection reverse.

tokens.name: --muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, labels, captions, nav idle.

tokens.name: --soft

tokens.name: --accent
tokens.usage: One live dot on the CTA. Never a surface colour.

rules: One ink, one ground, one accent. No second accent, no gradients as decoration.
Borders are 0.5px var(--stroke); shadows only for the fixed glass header and the guide.
Borders are 0.5px var(--stroke); shadows only for the fixed glass header and the guide.

sans.note: Variable weight axis. 400 for body, 500 for names, figures and emphasis. Never 600+.

mono.note: Only for indices, category labels, the contact seal and the footer meta. Uppercase, tracking +0.04em.

roles.name: large-title
roles.usage: Oversized figures. In this project: optional stat figures and the kit specimen.

roles.name: hero-title
roles.usage: The one headline on the page. Max width 900px, text-wrap: balance.

roles.name: title-2
roles.usage: Lede under a section label; the longest reading paragraph that is still large.

roles.name: body
roles.usage: Paragraphs, section labels, steps, case copy. Max line length 68–75 characters.

roles.name: footnote
roles.usage: Nav, buttons, captions, metric descriptions, footer.

rules: A role is a bundle: size, leading and tracking move together. Never borrow one from another role.
Sizes step at 1100px and 640px; they do not scale with the viewport.
Headline weight is 500, body is 400. No 600/700 — it breaks the Apple-like texture.
Text above 26px gets negative tracking; small text keeps its air.
Use .txt (text-box-trim: trim-both; text-box-edge: cap alphabetic) on display text where supported.

grid.formula: centred: equal side margins; at the cap 3 × 450px cards + 2 × 24px gutters
grid.rail: shared .content-rail: --edge clamp(16px, 22vw, 320px), margin-inline auto; rows and works use it
grid.guideLane: the right margin is also the guide lane: Буп sits 24px from the edge and his bubble opens left, so the cards stop before it

alignment.works: full grid width, cards left-aligned inside the grid
alignment.bodyCopy: left-aligned inside the statement blocks, centred in the hero and footer

layout.spotlight: a fixed white radial light follows the pointer behind the page (opacity 0.72, 620px); the closing block has its own stronger version

rules: 8-point grid; 4px is the only half-step, for an icon beside its label.
Gaps are measured between ink, not boxes. Optical corrections are allowed and expected.
Card padding 32px inside trays, 24px on mobile.

radii.concentricRule: inner radius = outer radius − padding, so corners stay parallel.

principles: Motion answers an action or explains a change. There is no decoration loop except the character and the fan.
One orchestrated entrance per page; the rows are the one looping decoration, and they pause.
Animate transform and opacity only. Never blur text mid-animation: Safari rasterises it and snaps.
rAF loops park themselves off screen and when the tab is hidden.
prefers-reduced-motion: no flight, no auto-rotation, no parallax; state changes are instant.

loader.count: ease-out cubic to 100, holds at 99 until fonts and first images are ready, ceiling 3000ms
loader.character: EyeTracker idle, cycling Cube → Hexagon → Pill → Circle every 440ms

heroEntrance.title: translateY(18px)→0, opacity 0→1, 700ms, starts 160ms after reveal
heroEntrance.guide: pops in over the reserved mark; the fixed header is already there

mobileMenu.burger: bars translate then rotate; 200ms translate, 300–350ms rotate
mobileMenu.dismiss: link tap, burger, Escape; the pill stays above the sheet; page sections go inert

ctaGlass.rim: 1.2px masked ring, radial from the pointer
ctaGlass.icon: arrow out 250ms, calendar in 400ms rotate(-30deg) scale(.6)→none

socialIcons.note: The reference's simulated ball, plane and jelly are not ported; three glyphs do not need a physics loop.

sequences.languageSwap: out 180ms to blur(4px) opacity 0, in 260ms — reference only; the build is RU-only

eyeTracker.follow: spring k=.06, damping .34 − bounce/100 × .22, per 1/60s frame
eyeTracker.shapeMorph: 520ms with 30% overshoot, eased radii sampled at 120 rays
eyeTracker.typeLine: 38ms + 0–30ms random per letter, hold 1500ms, never the same line twice

guide.trigger: gap header → ball ≈ 24px; no cross-screen travel
guide.exit: 260ms; 0–32% starts 10px in the direction of the exit, then opacity 0 + scale .7
guide.teleport: outer box jumps to the opposite resting place while invisible
guide.enter: 420ms from 30px offset with a slight overshoot; the same animation as the exit, reversed
guide.reverse: scroll up below trigger − 40px; the pair runs backward
guide.notes: section notes only when settled; typed at 38ms/letter and held 4.2s
guide.devtools: red body #E23434, furrowed brows, red bubble, “Куда полез? Это не для тебя.”
guide.reducedMotion: no out/in animation; the view switches at the trigger
guide.hover: one brow, instant (no animation beyond the eye spring)
guide.idle: 30s → eyes close to 12% of their height; z z z bob and brighten over 2.8s, staggered 0.32s
guide.rage: after a snark line: 560ms wind-up and flight 120vw right; 10s off-screen; 480ms bounce in with a return line

paint.trigger: IntersectionObserver at 14% visible; the works grid uses its existing lit observer
paint.reducedMotion: no blobs; the target background and the copy are there immediately

rows.layout: two rows of 16:9 case cards, duplicated for a seamless loop; opposite directions
rows.speed: 86s and 98s linear; the right row starts −24s out of phase
rows.hover: both tracks pause while the rows block is hovered
rows.mask: horizontal fade of clamp(40px, 6vw, 120px) at both edges
rows.reducedMotion: no movement; the first cards stay as a still strip

reducedMotion: Loader: no traverse, curtain fades out 300ms.
No hero flight, no wave, no sheen, no tooltip blur.
EyeTracker jumps to the target instead of springing; still blinks.
Guide: no out/in pair; the view switches at the trigger.
Rows: no marquee; the strip is still.

buttonPrimary.usage: Rare: the nav call on mobile.

ctaFace.portrait: 48px circle, 2px page-coloured ring, 10px accent dot at the lower right
ctaFace.usage: The one main action: Telegram in the hero and contact.

caseTile.shape: 16:9 preview in a centred CSS grid: 3 columns from 1360px, 2 below, 1 on phones; the card art is a live screenshot (CSS covers remain only as a fallback)
caseTile.artwork: the CSS CaseCover fills the whole card; no frame, no padding
caseTile.hover: dark wash from the bottom, the name, index and label rise; the artwork scales 1.025 and an arrow disc appears top-right
caseTile.touch: with no hover the wash and the name stay visible
caseTile.filter: chips; a hidden card is display:none and the grid reflows
caseTile.reveal: cards fade/rise 0.7s, 55ms apart, once per page

nav.desktop: one fixed glass pill, always visible: face | Gooey Nav | Telegram
nav.gooey: ReactBits Gooey Nav, light theme, ink active pill, 4 items (Начало · Работы · О себе · Контакты); the active item follows the section in view
nav.position: fixed top 24px, centred, width max-content; no hide, no second version
nav.mobile: the same pill full width (16px sides, 56px tall): face | burger; the full-screen sheet opens under the pill, the pill stays above it

footerSocial.alive: mail buzz; GitHub and Telegram change colour only

tooltip.status: reference only — the build uses native title on the three social glyphs
tooltip.placement: 8px above or below, one per group
tooltip.cardVariant: 30px radius, 24px top padding, 216px min width, floating shadow

loader.curtain: --bg full screen, z 50, count at 14.7% from the bottom in --soft
loader.layers: 100, above the header and the guide

kit.usage: Internal page at #kit: tokens, roles, icons, motion table, components.
kit.visibility: Linked from the footer in mono 12, not part of the employer path.

contactSeal.ring: SVG textPath in IBM Plex Mono 10.5px / 0.14em, “ОТКРЫТ К ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЯМ · FRONTEND DEVELOPER · MINSK · REMOTE”
contactSeal.face: ink disc 72px (60 mobile) with two ground-coloured bars: the character as a stamp
contactSeal.motion: 44s linear rotation, pauses on hover, stops under prefers-reduced-motion

contactSpotlight.source: the Spotlight Card idea, used as an ambient wash, not a card
contactSpotlight.behaviour: follows a mouse pointer inside the contact block, fades in over 500ms, ignored on touch

guide.name: Буп
guide.role: A whole character: starts on the hero mark, narrates sections, goes angry at DevTools.
guide.trigger: any scroll past 4px docks it at once; no ride-up phase
guide.exit: 170ms: starts moving 10px left, then fades and scales to .7
guide.teleport: the outer box moves to the right dock while the inner is invisible; it never travels across the page
guide.enter: 300ms from 30px left of the dock, scale .7 → 1.05 → 1, opacity 0 → 1
guide.reverse: scrolling up below trigger − 40px plays the same pair in the other direction (exit right, enter from the right)
guide.settle: the right dock is 52% of the viewport (79% mobile), 24px / 16px from the edge; the bubble opens left
guide.notes: project lines and jokes on hover; a hello once per visit; a quiet line every ~1 minute while docked; typing 38ms/letter
guide.devtools: red body + red bubble; the brows furrow, the eyes stay
guide.idle: 30s → sleeping; z z z bobbing above the head (all three visible, 0.32s stagger); reduced motion shows them static
guide.pokeRage: 4 quick pokes → snark line; a 560ms flight 120vw to the right; 10s away; 480ms bounce back + a line

return: Я вернулся. Тыкать больше не надо.

guide.dock: the ball is 72px, 24px from the right edge; a soft drop shadow keeps it on the page; the bubble opens left, its tail touching the ball; hidden on phones
guide.mobileDock: 52px, 16px from the edge; the bubble narrows to 176px
guide.bubble: messenger shape: ink fill, 18px radius with a 6px corner toward the tail, a 12px rotated square tail inheriting the fill, 200px max width, pops in from the tail with a slight blur
guide.return: after the rage the guide re-plants itself on the spot that matches the current scroll before flying back in, so it never returns crooked
guide.sleep: 30s idle: closed lids as arcs, straight brows above, bold z z z at the ball’s shoulder
guide.mobile: hidden under 640px: the character already lives in the header mark, and the floating ball only covered content

paintBlock.what: the background of a block alternates black/white and paints in on scroll; the content, covers and layout stay put
paintBlock.base: the opposite tone: ink target starts white, paper target starts ink
paintBlock.paint: three blurred target-colour blobs (filter blur 22px + contrast 24) merge, then a solid pass settles; the copy fades in over the same beat
paintBlock.delays: 70ms per tile, 1.1s blob merge, 820ms solid, 520ms copy; reduced motion shows the final state at once
paintBlock.usedOn: works tiles (strict alternation) and the about (paper) / process (ink) trays

rows.card: 16:9, clamp(190px,20vw,330px), radius 18, the CSS CaseCover inside
rows.rows: two, 16px apart, opposite directions; duplicated sets for a seamless loop
rows.width: calc(100% - 208px), matching the works; the right 104px is the guide lane

projectSheet.element: a native <dialog> in the top layer: Escape, focus trap and inert background come from the browser
projectSheet.size: min(1120px, 100vw - 48px), max-height 92vh, radius 28; full screen on phones
projectSheet.band: flat ink, no gradients: index, chip, title, summary, a 3-column fact row, then Буп
projectSheet.assistant: Буп, 64px, pops in after 0.2s with one of the project’s six lines in a white messenger bubble
projectSheet.scroll: :-webkit-scrollbar is hidden and scrollbar-width: none — the sheet scrolls without a visible bar
projectSheet.links: one row per site with hostname; twelve sites in Автобус 1; hover lifts the row to white
projectSheet.close: sticky 42px circle at the top right; backdrop click and Escape animate out in 190ms

projectCarousel.behaviour: native horizontal scroll-snap, one 16:10 stage: arrows, thumbnails, counter, ArrowLeft/Right, touch swipe
projectCarousel.arrows: 44px white discs, hidden at the ends
projectCarousel.counter: mono 10px in an ink pill at the top right, aria-live
projectCarousel.thumbs: 46px on their own row under the caption; the strip scrolls without a bar
projectCarousel.tall: portrait phone shots use object-fit: contain on a near-black stage

about.layout: on the shared content rail (same width as rows and works): section label, a 28–40px statement, a secondary paragraph, then one paper slab
about.slab: radius 28, 40px padding, painted on scroll; four stack groups in a row, a rule, then three fact columns
about.mobile: stack 1 column, facts 1 column, slab radius 22

process.layout: on the shared rail: label, a 760px lede, then an ink slab with four rows
process.row: grid 52 / 220 / 1fr — mono number, 22px title, 16px text; 1px top rule; hover lightens the row
process.mobile: number and title in one row, text under it

iconography.fill: none by default; brand marks (GitHub, Telegram, LinkedIn) are filled paths
iconography.optical: align icons to the cap-height centre of the text beside them, not the line box
iconography.style: Quiet, slightly rounded, uniform weight. No duotone, no filled UI icons, no 2px strokes.

character.name: EyeTracker
character.render: SVG ball with a clipped pair of rounded rect eyes on a sphere; eyes foreshorten with the turn

props.follow: 0–100, how far the ball turns toward the pointer (default 60)
props.shape: Ball | Circle | Cube | Pill | Hexagon | Hex flat (default Cube)
props.idle: mark mode: ignores the pointer, glances every 5s, blinks every 2s
props.within: CSS selector for the box it watches; the face returns to centre outside it
props.say: { text, id } — an outside line: the guide narrates the section in view through the same bubble
props.onHover: (over: boolean) => void — lets the guide turn kind while the ball is hovered
props.onPoke: () => string | false | void — the guide can replace or suppress the random poke line
props.sleeping: boolean — closes the eyes to a line; the brows relax; no blinking

where.settings: size 25, shape Circle, eyes Dots, idle
where.role: The brand mark; eyes in --bg on an --ink body. A click cycles the shape.

where.settings: size 108 in the hero, 72 docked; shape Cube, eyes Slant, eyeScale 1.18, follow 70
where.role: Starts over the hero mark, shifts right after a small scroll, narrates the blocks and comes back on scroll-up.

behaviour.watching: The pointer is tracked only inside .hero; outside it the face relaxes to centre.
behaviour.poke: A press (never a drag) opens a speech bubble at the lower right, types one line, holds it 1.5s, folds away.
behaviour.blink: Every 2.6–5.8s, a 160ms squash; idle marks blink every 2s.
behaviour.future: The bubble is the seam for visitor interaction: canned lines now, an intent/contact flow later.

guide.dock: right margin, 72px desktop (52px mobile), 24px / 16px from the edge, vertical 52% / 79%; soft drop shadow; the bubble tail touches the ball
guide.speech: on hover: the case line or a joke (40%); on open of a project sheet: one of six lines; a greeting from twenty on the first visit; a quiet line about once a minute
notes: CRM: поиск, резервы, договоры. Пять таблиц в одном окне.
Магазин с нуля: каталог, витрина и адаптив. Всё работает.
Приглашение вместо PDF: сценарий, музыка и анимация.
Диплом: собрал всё сам — от структуры до последнего отступа.
Внутренние приложения Avtobus1: формы, таблицы, Kendo UI.
Этот сайт: своя дизайн-система, персонаж и никакой UI-библиотеки.
guide.devtools: red body #E23434, eyes ±28°, red bubble: “Куда полез? Это не для тебя.”
guide.hover: one brow up while the ball is hovered
guide.idle: after 30s of no activity: eyes closed, z z z; wake on any pointer / scroll / key / touch
guide.pokeRage: 4 pokes in 3s → snark, leave the screen, 10s away, return with a funny line; pokes during that are ignored
guide.sleeping: the guide never sleeps while angry or away
guide.sleep: after 30s: the eye bars become shallow arcs, the brows stay straight, bold z z z with a white halo sits at the shoulder

tokenMapping.note: Bencho's tokens are mapped to this project's own tokens instead of being redefined as globals.

css.frame: 200 × 200, grid place-items center; size comes from --eyt-size on the root
css.bubble: left calc(50% + size × .36), top calc(50% + size × .3), radius 6 14 14 14, tint fill, white text 13

persona.name: Буп
persona.role: The site guide: the same eye ball, but a character with a name, a voice and a route.
persona.label: aria-label="Буп, гид по сайту"

quirks.devtools: when docked DevTools opens (outer/inner delta > 160px on desktop), the body turns #E23434, the brows furrow and the bubble turns red: “Куда полез? Это не для тебя.” The eyes never move.
quirks.limits: undocked DevTools does not change the window delta, so it is not detected; the check is desktop-only (>760px) to avoid false positives on phones.
quirks.hover: the pointer on the ball raises one brow (curious)
quirks.idle: 30 seconds without pointermove / scroll / key / touch → sleeping, eyes closed, z z z floating; any activity wakes
quirks.pokeRage: 4 pokes within 3 seconds → red, a snark line, a 560ms flight off the right edge, 10 seconds away, then a bounce back with a funny line

moods.curious: one brow up (the right one, −16°, lifted 2.8); the left stays flat — on hover
moods.kind: both brows lifted 1.8 units and angled −14° / +14° (inner ends up) — after a poke
moods.angry: brows closer to the eyes and angled +22° / −22° (inner ends down)
moods.rule: between the four expressions only the brows change: angle, gap and lift. The eyes stay put. Sleeping is a separate state: the eyes close, the brows relax.

hero.mark: a 136px reserved spot at the top of the copy, where the fixed guide starts
hero.title: Сайты, которые приносят заявки.
hero.lede: Я Виталик, фронтенд-разработчик. Делаю и поддерживаю сайты и интерфейсы: B2B-витрины, лендинги, CRM. В портфолио — БигФудМаркет, Golden Motors и сайты холдинга Bus1.
hero.layout: full viewport (100svh): 15 rows of logo tiles drifting in alternating directions behind the copy, a radial paper veil in the centre, then mark, title, lede and CTA
hero.wall: rows of 64px tiles with 9px gaps, enough tiles to fill the viewport twice per row at any size (630 at 1440×1000, 306 at 390×844); rows run 68–114s, every other row in reverse; pointer brings a tile to full contrast
hero.logos: public/logos/*.svg from Simple Icons: JS, TS, React, Next, Redux, Vite, HTML5, Sass, Node, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Python, .NET, Docker, npm, Webpack, Tailwind, Git, GitHub, Figma, Vercel, Netlify, OpenCode, Cursor, Claude, DeepSeek, Telegram, Google; GPT, 1C and C# are type tiles

works.layout: a centred wall of 16:9 previews: 3 columns from 1360px, 2 below, 1 on phones; every card is a real screenshot of the live site; hover lifts the name and Буп answers with a fact or a joke; a click opens the project sheet

page.process: Four steps: Понять, Спроектировать, Собрать, Проверить.
page.about: Short first-person paragraph plus stack and facts in a tray.
page.contact: Rotating contact seal, pointer spotlight, title, line, CTA, three socials, copyright. No hanging badge.
page.navNote: Telegram lives in the pill on desktop and in the sheet on a phone.
page.rows: Two 16:9 preview rows moving in opposite directions, edges masked, hover pauses; shares the works rail, so the right lane stays clear for the guide.

voice: First person, plain verbs, no selling adjectives.
A sentence does one job. No 'passionate', no 'innovative', no 'cutting-edge'.
Concrete over grand: name the tool, the flow, the edge case.
Russian copy; code identifiers and stack names stay in English.
rules: No invented metrics. Numbers appear only when they are verifiable.
No fake client logos. Cases link to real URLs or GitHub.
A CTA names exactly what happens: 'Написать в Telegram', not 'Связаться'.

accessibility.contrast: Body ink on bg 16.4:1; muted on bg 5.9:1; white on ink 17.4:1.
accessibility.focus: 2px ink outline, 3px offset, 4px radius; buttons may use an inset ring.
accessibility.targets: 48 × 48px minimum for fingers; 40 × 48 for footer glyphs.
keyboard: EyeTracker is a labelled image and does not trap focus
Guide: a labelled group; section notes are aria-live, the ball is clickable, no keyboard trap.
accessibility.reducedMotion: All movement gated; the loader becomes a fade; the rows are static; the character still blinks but does not spring.
accessibility.semantics: One h1, section landmarks, aria-pressed on filters and language, aria-expanded on the burger.

doNot: Do not add gradients as backgrounds for sections.
Do not put shadows under cards; only the glass header and the guide lift.
Do not use a second accent colour.
Do not put shadows under cards; only the glass header and the guide lift.
Do not animate width, height, top or left; use transform.
Do not blur text in or out on scroll.
Do not invent numbers, employers or client names.
Do not redefine Bencho's CSS variables as new globals; map them to project tokens.
Do not hide the header or introduce a second header state; it is one fixed glass pill.
Do not let the guide cover the contact CTA at rest; its notes are transient and pointer-events none.
Do not make the guide travel across the page; it leaves and reappears.
Do not rotate the eyes for a mood; the brows carry the expression.
Do not let the guide sleep while it is angry, away or showing DevTools.
Do not animate the eyes for a mood; only the brows move.
Do not let the guide or its works line sit over the case cards; the works line is a caption.
